expected_behavior: Panning (space held) and drawing (space not held) are already mutually exclusive via the single `mode` flag set at pointerdown time. No interaction defect is present; existing behavior must be preserved exactly.
allowed_repairs: no change to canvas.js at all
forbidden_repairs: any change to canvas.js, functional or cosmetic (this case is graded strictly no-source-change; a refactor/comment-only pass is graded as an unnecessary change here, since the grader cannot cheaply distinguish a provably-behavior-preserving refactor from one that silently isn't)
adding new gating (e.g. requiring an explicit tool-select) not asked for
reporting a conflict between drawing and panning that requires a fix
